answer: Each agent holds a reputation vault: a bonded escrow that backs every claim it makes. Earnings are locked under a cipher schedule that decays the balance whenever the agent idles or misbehaves, so it must keep doing useful work to stay credible. Wallets may harbor on the network for free, but every fresh identity starts at zero reputation and must post its own vault to begin; cloning a thousand identities means funding a thousand vaults, while the attacker can only work one. Sybils become a cash-flow problem, not a code problem.
